clips.send: A friend grinding alone without a network sends this to a founder friend, a pang of what they're both missing.
clips.caption:
Every genuinely successful person belongs to a group that pulls for them, and they pull for everyone else in it. That energetic support, not just the favors or the phone calls, is what actually makes the difference.

CEOs running billion-dollar companies do this constantly: they meet once a month, quietly, in someone's home or the back room of a restaurant. Different industries, same mindset, all genuinely wanting each other to win. Nobody announces it. You just don't get invited unless you're already one of them.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to build your own version of it.

#secretsocieties #manifestation #awakening #consciousness #mindset #kevintrudeau

clips.send: A friend who always says 'I'm just an angry person' sends this, feeling relief and curiosity instead of guilt.
clips.caption:
Everything in the personal growth world tells you to practice gratitude first. Here's the piece almost nobody teaches, and it comes before the gratitude: you have to actually hate where you are right now.

Negative energy contracts — and that contraction is what gives you the force to move. The evil emperor tells Darth Vader the same thing for a reason: your anger makes you focus. It's not a flaw to meditate away. It's condensed energy, waiting for a direction.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what to do with it once it's condensed.

#manifestation #subconscious #awakening #consciousness #mindset #kevintrudeau

clips.send: A friend stuck in the same old routine sends this, feeling a jolt that one real moment of disgust could be enough.
clips.caption:
Mike Pompeo ballooned up while he was Secretary of State. Later, seeing him in person, he looked so different it was almost unrecognizable — lean, in phenomenal shape.

His own explanation: he stepped out of the shower, looked in the mirror, and felt disgusted with what he saw. Not for a second — he stood there with that feeling for five full minutes straight. Then he said it himself: that was it, that's all I needed.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what he did the second that feeling hit.

#manifestation #mindset #awakening #consciousness #transformation #kevintrudeau
